note: Seventh distinct shape: wrapped in 'meta' + 'bikes', with good_for as a pipe-delimited string and abs stored as text rather than a boolean.

bikes.name: Royal Enfield Classic 350
bikes.about: The thump and the presence are the whole point. Comfortable at 80-100 kmph all day; heavy in traffic and slow to stop.

bikes.name: Royal Enfield Himalayan 450
bikes.about: A genuine long-distance adventure bike with a modern liquid-cooled engine. Tall seat and weight make city use tiring.

bikes.name: Honda Activa 6G
bikes.about: The default Indian commuter: unbreakable, cheap to run, and anyone can ride it. Useless above 60 kmph and no ABS.

bikes.name: TVS Apache RTR 160 4V
bikes.about: The sharpest-handling 160 with real power for the class. Vibrations creep in past 90 kmph and only single-channel ABS.

bikes.name: Bajaj Pulsar N250
bikes.about: The cheapest way into a 250cc twin-disc bike with dual-channel ABS. Refinement is a step below the Japanese competition.

bikes.name: Yamaha MT-15 V2
bikes.about: Light, revvy and the best-finished bike in its class, with a slipper clutch and USD forks. Small tank and a firm seat limit long rides.

bikes.name: KTM Duke 390
bikes.about: The most power per rupee here, with cornering ABS and a quickshifter. Harsh ride, high running costs and a hot engine in traffic.

bikes.name: Honda CB350 H'ness
bikes.about: A smoother, more reliable alternative to the Classic with better fuel economy. Lacks the character some buyers are actually paying for.

bikes.name: Hero Splendor Plus
bikes.about: The highest mileage and the lowest running cost of anything on this list. Nothing else about it is remarkable, which is rather the point.

bikes.name: Ola S1 Pro Gen 3
bikes.about: Very quick off the line and costs about 20 paise a kilometre to run. Service quality and software bugs are the recurring complaint.

bikes.name: Ather 450X Gen 3
bikes.about: The best-built electric scooter with a genuinely good touchscreen and charging network. Range drops sharply in sport mode.

bikes.name: TVS Jupiter 125
bikes.about: The most practical scooter here: biggest underseat storage, external fuel filler and a comfortable ride. Not fast.

bikes.name: Bajaj Dominar 400
bikes.about: The cheapest bike here that will cruise at 120 kmph in comfort all day. Heavy, and the mileage is poor for the segment.

bikes.name: Yamaha R15 V4
bikes.about: A proper small sportbike with a quickshifter and traction control. The committed riding position punishes daily city commutes.

bikes.name: Suzuki Access 125
bikes.about: The most refined 125cc scooter engine and the lightest to manoeuvre. Storage is smaller than the Jupiter's.

bikes.name: Royal Enfield Hunter 350
bikes.about: The Royal Enfield that actually works in a city: lighter, shorter and much easier to flick around. Small tank and a firm rear.

bikes.name: Kawasaki Ninja 300
bikes.about: A smooth parallel twin that sounds and feels far more expensive than a single. Dated on paper and costly to service.

bikes.name: Hero Xpulse 200 4V
bikes.about: The cheapest genuine off-road-capable bike sold in India, with 21-inch front wheel and long travel. Underpowered on highways.

bikes.name: TVS Ronin 225
bikes.about: A relaxed scrambler-styled all-rounder with a comfortable seat and dual-channel ABS. Not fast enough to excite.

bikes.name: Honda Shine 125
bikes.about: The most refined 125cc commuter with a genuinely smooth engine and low maintenance. Styling is entirely forgettable.

bikes.name: Triumph Speed 400
bikes.about: A big-brand roadster with premium components at a domestic price. Arguably the best all-round motorcycle here; service network is still thin.

bikes.name: Jawa 42 Bobber
bikes.about: Single-seat bobber styling that gets attention everywhere and a low seat anyone can flat-foot. Only one seat, and the ride is stiff.

bikes.name: Suzuki Gixxer SF 250
bikes.about: A fully faired 250 that is still comfortable enough to commute on, with excellent refinement. Modest power for the price.

bikes.name: TVS iQube S
bikes.about: Quiet, easy and backed by a large service network, which matters more than specifications for an EV. Range is the shortest here.
